description: The firm's product record. publish_source gives an app a url and bearer to POST events; record writes one; count, distinct, funnel, retention and query (SQL) read it on the firm's own calendar.

op.description: publish_source | unpublish_source | list_sources: the apps that may POST. record: one event now. count | distinct | funnel | retention: the fixed reads. query: SQL over the table `metrics`.

caller.description: publish_source / unpublish_source: who the bearer is for, e.g. 'website' or 'pos'. Publishing again for the same caller rotates the token.

event.description: record, count, distinct, retention: the event name, <resource>.<action_past>, e.g. member.checked_in.

subject_id.description: record: who or what took the step — a contact_id, a device, an account. The firm's own id.

at.description: record: when, ISO 8601. Omit for now.

properties.description: record: flat scalars that ride along, e.g. {"plan": "monthly", "location": "pier"}.

events.description: funnel: the steps in order, e.g. ["lead.captured", "member.joined", "member.checked_in"].

window.description: Reads: today | this_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | last_7_days | last_30_days | last_90_days, on the firm's calendar. Default this_month. Or set start and end.

start.description: Reads: window start, ISO date or datetime in the firm's zone. With end, replaces window.

end.description: Reads: window end, exclusive, ISO date or datetime in the firm's zone.

grain.description: count, distinct, retention: the period size. Default day. distinct at day/week/month is DAU/WAU/MAU.

by.description: count: a property to group by as well, e.g. 'plan'.

sql.description: query: SQL over the table `metrics` (event, subject_id, ts, via, properties map). Athena (Trino) syntax.
